tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len mdor bsdus ngag bsgrigs bzhugs so//

phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer bsdus pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga dang ldan pas nyams su len par 'dod na/ ngag tu/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum brjod/ rang gi spyi bor zla steng hūm̐ yig dang*// rdo rje las skyes rdo rje sems dpa' ni// mdog dkar dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan// rdo rje dril 'dzin sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa// ye shes pa dang gnyis med thugs ka ru// zla steng hūm̐ mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor// sngags bzla'i dus su sngags phreng sa bon las| |bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab rang gi tshangs bug zhugs// sgrib pa kun sbyangs bdud rtsis lus gang gyur// yig brgya ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ rdor sems dgyes tshul sdig sgrib dag go zhes// gnang ba bstsal nas bdag la thim par gyur// dang po byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// rdzogs byang thob la bdag yid kun nas smon// de phyir bdag gis lam 'dir rab zhugs nas| |bdag don bsgrubs te 'gro rnams bsgral bar bgyi// gnyis pa yi dam bsgom pa ni/ snod bcud rang bzhin ma grub stong pa'i ngang*// bsrung ba'i gur khang rdo rje me ri'i dbus// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pad+ma dang*// nyi ma 'jigs dus gdan la rang gi sems// rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan| |'od 'phros 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs he ru ka'i// go 'phang la bkod phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod// thugs rje kun bsdus hūm̐ dang rdo rjer bstims| |de nyid yongs gyur bdag nyid he ru kaḥ /mig sman ltar gnag mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can// spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra dmar ser g.yo| |ral pa thor tshugs rin chen zla ba dang*// sna tshogs rdo rjes rab spen thod skam lnga// rdo rjes sbrel ba skra mtshams steng du spras// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dar dpyangs brgyan// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum stag gi sham thabs grol// rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang thal chen spras// phyag gnyis thugs kar rdor dril bsnol ba'i pang*// shes rab yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dmar mo g.yas pa gri gug phyogs bcur gdengs// g.yon pa thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud// phyag rgya lnga ldan thod dum ske rag bcings// spyan gsum mche gtsigs chags nyams yab dang sbyor// g.yon brkyang g.yas zhabs yab kyi sked la 'khril// gcer mo khrag 'dzag khrag la dgyes pa'i nyams// yab yum gnas gsum 'khor pad rdo rje'i dbus| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dkar dmar nag pos mtshan//

'bar ba'i rgyas/ snying khar nyi dbus hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes sems dpa' dam tshig pa la bstim// dbang lhas bdag la dbang bskur stsol cig ces// gsol ba btab tshe dbang lha yab yum gyis// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs bum chus dbang bskur dri ma dag /chu lhag gyen 'khyil yab la mi bskyod pa// yum la rtag pa'i rdo rjes dbu brgyan cing*// dbang lha rang thim rang nyid lha ru gsal// yun ring du bsgom/ snod bcud rten dang brten pa'i rang nyid can// phung khams skye mched phyi nang tshigs dang bcas// gdan gsum tshang ba'i ngo bor dag pa nyid// gdod nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i rang bzhin nga'o// zhes dran zhing brtan par bya'o// gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang mdun gyad dang seng ges bteg pa'i khrir// pad zla nyi steng rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// mthing nag dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras| |dbu skra thor tshugs mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar// rdo rje'i skyil krung phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// pang du rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// sngo bsangs gri thod yab 'khyud rgyan gyis spras// gcer bu pad skyil yab dang gnyis med 'khril// dus gsum sangs rgyas mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon nyid// de la rtsa brgyud bla mas yongs su bskor// mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi rol ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas// nyi zla rgya mtsho rtsi shing sman dang 'bru// dgos pa kun tshang stong gsum 'jig rten tshogs// zhum pa med par rgyal ba rnams la 'bul// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ji snyed pa// bdag lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa bar bcas// dus gsum mchod pa'i rnam pa gang mchis pa// 'gro ba'i don slad 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol//

zhes dbul/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang til+li pa// nā ro mar mi dwags po phag mo gru// 'jig rten gsum mgon nas brgyud dam pa'i tshogs// bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam chos srung la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de skad gsol btab bla ma yab yum gnyis// snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams byang chub sems// dkar dmar mthing gsum rgyun bzhi rab bab pa// bdag gi dpral mgrin snying ga lte bar thim// sad rmi gnyid 'thug 'pho ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs// bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang rnams thob// sprul longs chos sku ngo bo nyid kyi sku// go 'phang mngon byas 'khor rnams gtso la thim// gtso bo yab yum snyoms 'jug byang sems su// ltem gyis zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang bdag lus ngag /yid rnams dbyer med ro gcig 'dres par gyur// bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus// hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor dbu mar brgyud// rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab// yum gyi dhū ti nas brgyud zhal nas thon// rang gi zhal zhugs snying khar 'khor bar bsam/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus bzla/ bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// snod bcud rten dang brten pa 'od du zhu// srung 'khor la bsdus de yang yum la thim// yum ni yab la yab kyang thugs ka'i hūm̐// de yang zhabs kyu khog pa mgo zla tshes// thig le nā da la thim de nyid kyang*// mi dmigs gsal stong zung 'jug chen po'i ngang*// 'khor 'das kun gyi byed po rang gi sems| |mi bsam mi spro mi bsdu mi dgag cing*// rang babs snang ba rnam rtog ji snyed pa// gzung dang 'dzin bral bzo med khyab gdal ngang*// mnyam yangs chos sku'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag

| ces don gyi ngo bo la mnyam par bzhag /lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ bdag gzhan 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du// bsags dang rang bzhin rnam dag khams dge ba// gang mchis sems can kun slad byang chub bsngo// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus bdag gis len// bdag gi dge tshogs gang bgyis der smin shog / ces brjod lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol// de ltar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi| |nyams len mdor bsdus ma tshang med pa 'di// ljang grong dpon bsod ces pas bskul ba'i slad// dbur stod skyu ra'i rigs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// chos kyi grags pas bye ri stag rtser sbyar// ji ltar lan tshwa nyung zad tsam gyi ros// kha zas kun gyi bro ba skyed pa ltar// gnad bsdus lam gyi snying po nyung ngu 'dis// dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus rdzogs byed cing*// mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i nyams len tshang bar nges// //maṅga laṃ shu bhaṃ stu//
